title: Leanne Bentley “The Bike Changed Everything”
content:
Our friends at Schwalbe launched a YouTube series called “Heart and Hustle” last year and today, we’re sharing a Leanne Bentley profile.

Leanne rides to places most people only dream of — and sometimes, riding changes everything.

An ultra-distance mountain bike racer, graphic designer and bag maker, she has built a life around adventure, creativity and independence. From the Dale Divide to racing 2000 km across Kyrgyzstan, she knows what it means to push beyond your limits — and to let the road change you along the way.

For Leanne, cycling isn’t just about racing. It’s a way of seeing the world, finding freedom and discovering what’s possible when you keep moving forward.
